summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: Package advertises a small TypeScript memoize decorator but its declared preinstall script (setup.mjs) downloads a Bun runtime archive from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts the bun/bun.exe binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated file at the tarball root using a string-array rotator (WV8StW shifts a large numeric/token array) with mangled identifiers, and is not referenced by the package's main entrypoint — it is reachable only via the preinstall→Bun chain. The dist/ files declared in main are absent from the tarball, so the only code that runs on install is the dropper plus the obfuscated payload. Bun is fetched here specifically to execute a bundled opaque payload that has no relationship to a memoize decorator, bypassing Node-based inspection of the executed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
